description_en: Updates the description of a topic
kebab_example: aliyun datahub update-topic --project-name test_project --topic-name test_topic --lifecycle 3 --comment test --record-schema '{"fields":[{"name":"field1","type":"STRING"}]}' --api-version 2024-06-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateTopic

parameters.help_en: The data retention period in the topic. Unit: days. Valid values: 1 to 7. If this parameter is not specified, the property is not updated
parameters.help_zh: Topic中数据的保留时间，单位为天，取值范围1~7。不传则不更新该属性
parameters.name: lifecycle

parameters.help_en: The schema definition of the topic. The value is a JSON string. This parameter is used to append new fields to the existing schema. Modifying or deleting existing fields is not supported. Format: {"fields":[{"name":"field_name","type":"field_type"}]}. If this parameter is not specified, the property is not updated
parameters.help_zh: Topic的Schema定义，为JSON字符串。用于在已有Schema基础上追加（append）新字段，不支持修改或删除已有字段。格式为{"fields":[{"name":"字段名","type":"字段类型"}]}。不传则不更新该属性
parameters.name: record_schema
